definitions.explanation: The joint connecting the thigh bone and the lower leg bones, which lets the leg bend and straighten. It is one of the largest joints in the body.

examples.japanese: {膝|しつ}{関節|かんせつ}が{痛|いた}い。
{走|はし}りすぎて{膝|しつ}{関節|かんせつ}に{負担|ふたん}がかかった。
examples.english: I ran too much and put strain on my knee joint.

examples.japanese: {加齢|かれい}とともに{膝|しつ}{関節|かんせつ}の{軟骨|なんこつ}がすり{減|へ}り、{痛|いた}みが{出|で}ることがある。
examples.english: With aging, the cartilage in the knee joint wears down and pain can appear.

notes:
Composed of {膝|しつ} (knee) + {関節|かんせつ} (joint). An anatomy term; in this compound {膝|ひざ} takes its on'yomi しつ rather than the everyday reading ひざ.

USAGE:
- {膝|しつ}{関節|かんせつ}が{痛|いた}む: the knee joint aches
- {膝|しつ}{関節|かんせつ}に{負担|ふたん}がかかる: strain is placed on the knee joint

RELATED WORDS:
- {関節|かんせつ}: joint
- {軟骨|なんこつ}: cartilage — the tissue that cushions the joint
